description: Datasheet-derived stand-in for the SC/APC connector on a 0.9mm-fiber pigtail — the connector pre-installed on the OZ510 modules' fiber and on any pigtail plugged into the housing's internal adapter ports. Overall lengths from the Leviton GD102431 SC connector drawing (datasheets/): 38mm overall with the 0.9mm boot (2-3mm cable versions are 56mm — those do NOT fit the OZ510 dual housing's plenum). Plug/grip cross-sections follow the FOCIS-3 SC envelope. A PURCHASED/pre-terminated part — the model exists for mated-corridor keep-out checks and renders, not fabrication.
frame: Plug axis = +Y. Origin at the grip's FRONT face — the plane that stops against the adapter body end when mated. Plug shroud and ferrule extend +Y (into the adapter); grip, crimp, and boot extend -Y. Mated placement: put the origin on the adapter's end face, coaxial.
notes: Simplified: push-pull latch details, key, and boot curvature are approximated; the envelope (38mm overall, FOCIS-3 plug/grip cross-sections, 2.5mm ferrule) is what matters for corridor checks.
boot length is derived: overall_len - (ferrule_tip_y + grip_len + crimp_len).
When mated, the connector occupies ~overall_len - ferrule_tip_y = 25mm behind the adapter end — the OZ510 dual housing's mated_connector_clear (30mm) covers this with margin.
